entities.summary: Robert Keith Dibble is an American former Major League Baseball (MLB) pitcher and television and radio analyst. Dibble debuted in MLB with the Cincinnati Reds in 1988 and was named to two All-Star Games with the Reds. He was the 1990 National League Championship Series Most Valuable Player en route to the team's World Series win.
